(Dated this the 4 th day of February, 2025) This transfer petition has been filed seeking the transfer of O.P. No.541/2024 pending before the Family Court, Pathanamthitta, to the Family Court,
Kozhikode.
The petitioner is the wife of the respondent.
2. The petitioner and the respondent got married on 15.02.2010, and two children were born in the wedlock.
They were living in Dubai.
Initially, the respondent filed OP (Div) No.625/2022 before the Family Court, Pathanamthitta.

The petitioner had filed OP No.1179/2022, and MC No.320/2022 and a case under Section 498A of IPC against the respondent before the courts at Kozhikode. In the meantime, the dispute was settled, and they started to reside together.

Thereafter, the respondent filed O.P No.541/2024 before the Family Court, Pathanamthitta and the petitioner received a notice to appear TR.P(C) 613/2024 2025:KER:9069 before the Family Court, Pathananthitta.

3. The grievance of the petitioner is that since she is a lecturer at AWH Engineering College,
Kozhikode, she has to take leave to attend the case proceedings.
The children are studying in 8th standard, and it is difficult to make arrangements for their care while the petitioner goes to the Family Court, Pathanamthitta.
She also submits that the Family Court, Kozhikode, has jurisdiction over the matter, as the petitioner and the respondent last resided together at Kozhikode, as husband and wife.

4. The counsel for the respondent has no objection in transferring the petition to the Family Court,
Kozhikode.
In the result, this transfer petition is allowed.

O.P. No.541/2024 pending before the Family Court,
Pathanamthitta, is withdrawn and transferred to the Family Court, Kozhikode.

The Family Court,
Pathanamthitta, shall immediately transfer the records to the Family Court, Kozhikode.
The personal TR.P(C) 613/2024 2025:KER:9069 appearance of the respondent shall be dispensed with before the Family Court, Kozhikode, unless the presence is required.
The parties shall appear before the Family Court, Kozhikode, on 19.02.2025.

Sd/-
BASANT BALAJI JUDGE JS TR.P(C) 613/2024 2025:KER:9069 APPENDIX OF TR.P(C) 613/2024 PETITIONER ANNEXURES Annexure 1 A TRUE COPY OF THE NOTICE IN FORM NO.8 DATED 22-07-2024 IN O.P NO.541/2024 ON THE FILE OF THE FAMILY COURT, PATHANAMTHITTA,
ISSUED TO THE PETITIONER Vineetha Shamine.
